hero.lead: Dig through a box of cartridges from your phone. Filter with tags, compare two ratings and put your favourites on a wooden shelf.
hero.note: Free · Game data from IGDB and RAWG

features.eyebrow: From the box to your shelf
features.title: Eight gestures, from the first look to the shelf.
features.lead: Everything works with your thumb. Browsing needs no account.

items.title: Flip through the cartridges
items.text: Each game is a cartridge: cover, title, platform, year. Scroll, and the next one slides in.

items.title: Filter with tags
items.text: Genre, platform, year, rating. Filters combine and stay in the address, so you can share a search.

items.title: Search as you type
items.text: Results follow your fingers. An old answer never overwrites a newer one.

items.title: Open the game page
items.text: Visuals, description, platforms, studios and screenshots, all on one page.

items.title: Compare two ratings
items.text: The global community rating and the Cartouche players' rating, side by side, on the page and in the list.

items.title: Put it on the shelf
items.text: Favourite a game and its cartridge slides into place on your 3D shelf. It stays there when you close the tab.

items.title: Export an image
items.text: Your shelf, as you see it, as a PNG sized for a post or a story. Built in your browser.

items.title: Share a link
items.text: A link opens your shelf for a friend, read-only. No account for them, nothing to install.

shelf.title: Your favourites, racked on real wood.
shelf.lead: Each favourite goes on your 3D shelf, which fills up as you add games.
shelf.empty: No cartridge on the shelf yet.

profile.usernameHint: 3 to 20 characters: letters, digits, dashes and underscores.

items.title: Favourites on your account
items.text: Your favourites and ratings are saved. Find them again on any device.

items.title: Offline demo mode
items.text: A sample catalogue that works without a network connection or an account.

items.title: A huge catalogue
items.text: The game data comes from RAWG, the large open database of video games.

items.a: To browse, no: the catalogue and demo mode are open. To keep your favourites and ratings, yes: they are saved to your account.

items.q: What happens if I change phone?
items.a: Log in again and your shelf comes back exactly as it was.

items.q: Where does the Cartouche community rating come from?
items.a: From Cartouche accounts: one rating out of 5 per game and per person.

items.q: Can a friend change my shelf?
items.a: No. A shared link shows it read-only.
